versions.content: If transmission of Network Management PDUs has been started, the UdpNm Message Cycle Timer expires and when UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set either to FALSE or if set to TRUE and additionally the transmission of PN shutdown messages is inactive, then the UdpNm module shall transmit a Network Management PDU by calling SoAd_IfTransmit .
